newsitem.title: USA: GaSonics, LAM to take charges.
newsitem.headline: GaSonics, LAM to take charges.

text.p: GaSonics International Corp and Lam Research Corp reported Thursday they would take charges against earnings as a result of delinquent receivables accounts with Thailand-based SubMicron Technologies PLC.
GaSonics said in a statement it will take a pretax charge of $4.5 million for its third quarter, ended June 30.
Lam Research said in a statement it will take a charge of $6.5 million, or $0.15 a share, in its fourth quarter, ended June 30.

GaSonic and Lam Research were part of an informal group of creitors that has been in negotiations with SubMicron. Other companies involved were Applied Materials Inc, Novellus Systems Inc and Silicon Valley Group.
